definitions.device_methods: [допущение] a call of one of DEVICE_METHODS (read, readline, write, flush, send, recv, reset_input_buffer, send_output_report, set_raw_data_handler, ...) on a name or attribute chain whose last part, case-insensitive and without leading underscores, is in DEVICE_VOCABULARY = {serial, ser, port, sock, socket, conn, device, dev, reader, station, hid}; direction comes from the method; format is the device format of the module path (e.g. Sportiduino serial, SFR HID), `socket` for sock/socket/conn, else `device stream`
definitions.direction: read, write, both (read and write, or both in one call), device (only device calls), unknown (open with a non-literal mode)
definitions.file_parameter: [допущение] a read/readline/readlines/write/writelines call on a parameter of the enclosing function named file, f, fp, fh, fd, fobj or stream (FILE_VOCABULARY) is an I/O site of kind `file object (parameter)` unless a device rule already matched it; its direction comes from the method
definitions.host: a host or URL value is reported with kind url; newline and quotechar as delimiter
definitions.io_site: a call matching the API tables of formats.py (open family with the mode's direction; csv/json/orjson/xml/lxml/struct/zip/gzip/docx/jinja2/INI/PO; serial, socket, HTTP, SPORTident, HID, Impinj, printer; Path.read_*/write_*)
definitions.local_names: a non-empty string literal assigned to a local name is typed by that name like a constant (e.g. `sep = "\t"` is a delimiter)
definitions.protocol_rows: in the device paths of DEVICE_KINDS (libs/{sportiduino,sfr,srpid,huichang}, modules/{sportident,sfr,sportiduino,srpid,rfid_impinj,huichang}) a function without I/O calls gets a row (call `<protocol>`, direction decode/encode/both) when it has a non-empty bytes literal, `int.from_bytes`, `.to_bytes`, or byte arithmetic: `& | ^ << >>` with a hex mask or on an indexed value with an int, and, beyond the original list, `+ - * // %` on an indexed value with an int. encode = `.to_bytes` or a bytes literal that is not compared; decode = the rest. Named upper-case int constants referenced there are byte-constants
definitions.row: one per enclosing function, class body or module level with at least one I/O site; nested functions are rows of their own
definitions.values: literals in the same scope: keyword/positional parameters, strings classified by content, bytes and hex constants, ints in comparisons, subscripts and packing, and module or class constants referenced by name (tag at the assignment line, use_tag at the use)

values.origin: constant header_struck via first argument of struct.calcsize
constant header_struck via first argument of struct.unpack
constant header_struck via first argument of struct.pack
